description: Header file defining the FunctionsGLX class, which loads and manages GLX functions and data for OpenGL rendering on X11 systems, including context creation, extension querying, and buffer management.

classes.name: FunctionsGLX
classes.description: Class responsible for loading and interfacing with GLX functions and extensions, managing OpenGL context creation, buffer swapping, and querying GLX extensions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads GLX data and extensions for a given display and screen.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with GLX.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific GLX extension is supported.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a GLX rendering context with specified visual info.

methods.name: destroyContext
methods.description: Destroys a specified GLX context.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a GLX context current for a drawable.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers of a drawable.

methods.name: queryExtension
methods.description: Queries for a specific GLX extension error base and event.

methods.name: queryVersion
methods.description: Queries the GLX version supported.

methods.name: getCurrentContext
methods.description: Returns the current GLX context.

methods.name: getCurrentDrawable
methods.description: Returns the current GLX drawable.

methods.name: waitX
methods.description: Waits for X server events.

methods.name: waitGL
methods.description: Waits for GL execution to complete.

methods.name: getClientString
methods.description: Retrieves a client string from GLX.

methods.name: queryExtensionsString
methods.description: Returns a string of supported GLX extensions.

methods.name: getFBConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves available framebuffer configurations.

methods.name: chooseFBConfig
methods.description: Selects a framebuffer configuration matching attributes.

methods.name: getFBConfigAttrib
methods.description: Gets an attribute value from a framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: getVisualFromFBConfig
methods.description: Gets visual info from a framebuffer config.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a window surface with a framebuffer config.

methods.name: destroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys a window surface.

methods.name: createPbuffer
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: destroyPbuffer
methods.description: Destroys a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: queryDrawable
methods.description: Queries attributes of a drawable.

methods.name: createContextAttribsARB
methods.description: Creates a GLX context with specific attributes (ARB extension).

methods.name: swapIntervalEXT
methods.description: Sets swap interval (EXT extension).

methods.name: swapIntervalMESA
methods.description: Sets swap interval (MESA extension).

methods.name: swapIntervalSGI
methods.description: Sets swap interval (SGI extension).

methods.name: getSyncValuesOML
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization values (OML extension).
